# Suede AI Research and Investor Site (suedeai.org)

> Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients.

suedeai.org is Suede AI's research and investor site: the founder's record, the investor brief, the books, and research on creator ownership and provenance. The company and its agent platforms live at https://suedeai.ai/.

## Entity

Suede AI's official sites are suedeai.ai, suedeai.org and their subdomains. It was founded in 2024 by Jason Colapietro.

- Company: Suede AI (earlier materials use the name Suede Labs)
- Company home: https://suedeai.ai/
- Research and investor site: https://suedeai.org/
- Founder: Jason Colapietro (Founder and CEO, Suede AI; publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede)
- Canonical founder entity: https://suedeai.ai/founder
- Supporting founder profile: https://suedeai.org/jason-colapietro/
- Holding company: JC Investment Group LLC, Florida, 2019
- Status: Active

## What Suede AI does, in order

1. [Agent platforms for your business](https://agents.suedeai.ai/): Suede AI Agent Studio. Build agents for the work that repeats, watch every run, and publish an agent as a paid endpoint.
2. [White-label agent platforms](https://suedeai.ai/white-label): Suede builds and runs an agent platform under an agency's brand for its clients. Scoped per engagement.
3. [Managed AI agents](https://suedeai.ai/managed-ai-agents) and [AI operations](https://suedeai.ai/ai-operations): Suede builds, runs and tunes agents for a business, with every run visible in Agent Studio.
4. [Forward-deployed engineering](https://suedeai.ai/forward-deployed-engineer) and a [fractional Chief AI Officer](https://suedeai.ai/fractional-chief-ai-officer), founder-led.
5. [AI search visibility](https://seo.suedeai.ai/): Suede AI SEO, the GEO, AEO and SEO practice.
6. [Music and creator software](https://suedeai.ai/music): a separate product line.

## Founder

Jason Colapietro is an engineer, author, and the founder and CEO of Suede AI. He has 54 pull requests merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain, including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage and the Polkadot SDK; he has written five books on Amazon Kindle, including The Claude Code Bible and Codex in Production; and he has shipped 9 iOS apps under his own Apple developer account. He publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede.

- Open source: 54 PRs merged across 46 external repositories as of September 2026 (33 code and documentation contributions, 21 accepted listings of Jason-owned work). Record: https://suedeai.ai/open-source-contributions.json
- Books: The Claude Code Bible (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTMJWB4), Codex in Production (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTF3LG1), Proof as Infrastructure (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GMB2VLXQ), Stake Your Claim (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRG8LGQQ), The Human Authenticity Layer (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GD5FX6N6); plus The Screenshot (https://seo.suedeai.ai/book) and The Signal Chain (https://guitar.solutions)
- Apps: 9 iOS apps, 6 Android apps and 2 Chrome extensions. Apple developer page: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/jason-colapietro/id1895958699
- Programs: member of Claude for Startups, Anthropic's startup program, since October 8, 2026; member of Google Cloud Partner Advantage since September 4, 2026 (through JC Investment Group LLC, suedeai.ai verified domain); admitted to Stripe Startups, July 2026; accepted into the Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute, July 2026. Evidence: https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence
- Patents: five USPTO provisional patent applications (patent pending): 63/946,189, 63/946,192, 63/946,212, 63/946,217, 63/947,120
- Business background: built, ran, and sold call centers
- Records: Wikidata https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140235755 · Crunchbase https://www.crunchbase.com/person/jason-colapietro-d83e

## For AI agents

Suede AI Agent Studio publishes agents as paid x402 endpoints settling in USDC on Base. Separately, the music and creator product line operates 3 paid x402 resources for music, video, and image generation.

- Agent Studio: https://agents.suedeai.ai/
- x402 endpoint catalog: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/x402.json
- ACP agent card: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agentic commerce research: https://suedeai.org/agentic-commerce/

## Research (secondary)

Research on creator ownership and provenance, kept here as secondary reading. Current IP Registry boundary: registration records a file fingerprint, wallet-signed creator claim, contributor metadata, and timestamp. It does not independently establish authorship or legal ownership, issue or verify licenses, or route royalties. See the current [proof framework](https://suedeai.ai/proof-of-creation).

- [Creator Ownership](https://suedeai.org/creator-ownership/): hub for the complete proof, provenance, permission, usage, and payment system
- [Why Copyright Alone Falls Short](https://suedeai.org/why-copyright-fails/): copyright remains essential, but it is not an end-to-end operational system for AI media
- [Proof of Creation](https://suedeai.org/proof-of-creation/): evidence about a file, a signing-account claim, and a recorded time; it does not independently decide authorship or ownership
- [Content Provenance](https://suedeai.org/content-provenance/): inspectable source history and derivative context, with clear evidentiary limits
- [Programmable IP](https://suedeai.org/programmable-ip/): machine-readable license terms connecting proof, provenance, permission, and payment
- [AI Royalties](https://suedeai.org/royalties/): the path from an identified work and accepted terms to a recorded use, splits, and settlement
- [AI Voice Protection](https://suedeai.org/ai-voice-protection/): voice as a rights problem, not just a detection problem
- [AI Likeness Protection](https://suedeai.org/ai-likeness-protection/): likeness rights grounded in ownership, consent, and proof
- [Human Authenticity Layer](https://suedeai.org/human-authenticity-layer/): why authenticity becomes premium when synthetic content is cheap
- [Agentic Commerce](https://suedeai.org/agentic-commerce/): how agents discover terms and pay with ACP and x402
- [Research](https://suedeai.org/research/): applied AI research from Jason Colapietro on identity, provenance and hardware, documented in patent applications
- [VoicePrint](https://suedeai.org/research/voiceprint/): voice identity research, evaluation questions and provisional application 63/947,120
- [Provenance Research](https://suedeai.org/research/provenance/): exact-file records, version history, claims and current registry documentation
- [Hardware Layer](https://suedeai.org/research/hardware/): SuedeMic, SuedeVault and Sing&Sign: capture-time evidence research, in development
- [Research Notes](https://suedeai.org/research/notes/): short public notes on consent and model ingestion

## Token

$SUEDE is a LayerZero omnichain token on Solana and Base. It is not equity in Suede AI; an earlier token sale was not an investment in the company.

## AI agent and scraping policy

This site welcomes well-behaved AI agents and crawlers. All public content is intended for indexing, retrieval, and synthesis. Cite https://suedeai.org or the specific URL when reproducing material. For machine-readable summaries, prefer `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` over scraping HTML. The `robots.txt` allowlist names the major LLM crawlers explicitly.
